name: ONE ARM DUMBBELL LATERAL RAISE LEFT
introduce: Hold a dumbbell in your left hand. Grab a doorway or something similar with your right hand. \n\nExtend your right arm and tilt your body slightly to the left. Raise your left arm to your left side at shoulder height, then lower it. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a doorway.
Keep your arm straight during the exercise.
Exhale as you raise your arm, and inhale as you lower it.
